question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.**

The robbers were __captured__ and brought to the jail.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Released**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate **antonym** of the underlined word '**captured**' is '**released**'.
 
• **Captured**: to take a person or animal prisoner. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या पशु को बंदी बनाना)
 
 
• *Example: The lion was **captured** and taken back to the zoo.*
 
 
 
• **Released**: to allow somebody/something to be free. [व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को (किसी से या कहीं से) मुक्त करना, जाने देना]
 
 
• *Example: He’s been **released** from prison.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Released.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Composed**: made or formed from several different parts, people, etc. (विभिन्‍न घटकों, व्‍यक्तियों आदि से निर्मित)
 
• **Destroyed**: to damage something so badly that it can no longer be used or no longer exists. (किसी वस्‍तु को इस तरह हानि पहुँचाना कि वह इस्‍तेमाल न हो सके या समाप्‍त हो जाए, नष्‍ट करना)
 
• **Seized**: to take hold of something suddenly and firmly; to grab something. (किसी वस्‍तु को एकाएक और कसकर पकड़ लेना; छीन लेना, झपट लेना)
